name: Riccardo Galbiati
headline: MSc Media & Creative Industries
focus: Market Research · Quantitative Research · Consumer Insights
profile: Early-career consumer insights and market research graduate with an MSc in Media & Creative Industries and a BSc in Economics & Business. Hands-on experience designing surveys in Qualtrics, analysing quantitative data in SPSS and translating results into clear research conclusions. Experienced in qualitative interviews, audience research and applying insights to campaign positioning. Interested in rapid, practical research that helps brands test ideas and make informed decisions.

projects.title: Master's Thesis
projects.summary: Designed and distributed a Qualtrics survey investigating the effects of political disagreement with celebrities on audience attitudes and disengagement; analysed results using SPSS and interpreted patterns in responses.

projects.title: Marketing Campaign Development
projects.summary: Conducted audience research for a group campaign proposal for an alternative music festival; used insights into consumer motivations to inform campaign positioning, messaging and potential brand partnerships.

projects.title: Pre-Master's Thesis
projects.summary: Conducted semi-structured interviews with Italian music listeners aged 18–30; analysed responses to identify themes around authenticity, music discovery and listener identity.

projects.title: Audience Engagement Analysis
projects.summary: Analysed how Italian expats aged 20–35 in the Netherlands engage with Serie A content across streaming platforms and social media, examining motivations, participation and cross-platform behaviour.

experience.summary: Supported daily farm and hospitality operations, including guest reception and general maintenance.
